purpose: estimator comparison on the identical locked-point administered sets
rationale: Pick the estimator whose recovery slope is closest to 1. MLE has the nominally-closest slope (0.879) but MWLE (0.877) is within 0.003 (noise); MWLE is chosen as the deployment estimator because plain MLE diverges on all-pass/all-fail administrations (Warm's penalty keeps MWLE finite), matching the item-level study's headline.
